title: True Detective Mysteries
paragraphs: True-crime dramatizations drawn from cases published in True Detective magazine, often reconstructing an actual crime from the perspectives of investigators, victims, or criminals.

Long-running true-crime anthology based on cases from True Detective Mysteries magazine. Local RadioGOLDINdex identifies the represented programs 1-8 as TransAmerican syndication with local commercials.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Early network period (May 16, 1929 to May 8, 1930), 1936-37 transcribed/syndicated period (September 8, 1936 to August 31, 1937), Mutual/sponsored middle period (1938 to 1945), and Later revival/transcribed period (1946 to 1959).

The stories often return to true-crime case dramatization, true-crime magazine to radio adaptation, transcribed syndicated radio distribution, alternate encodes and rebroadcast preservation, murder investigation and prosecution, and criminal pursuit and case history.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes 1937 TransAmerican syndicated transcriptions, True Detective magazine case histories adapted for radio, Long-running True Detective radio property, and Frozen duplicate-encoding and rebroadcast structure.
